headline: SA October CPI rises to 5.2% from 4.5%, in line with the Reuters poll, a day before the SARB decision
summary: South Africa's annual consumer inflation rose to 5.2% in October from 4.5% in September, with prices up 0.7% on the month, in line with the 5.2% Reuters poll (Stats SA release via InstaForex, 18 Nov 2026 10:00 SAST). Before the release the rand was at R16.98/$, near a seven-month low, and the 2035 government bond yield was 8.625% (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 18 Nov 2026). Overnight, Nvidia beat estimates with $115.8bn revenue, while gold and platinum fell on Tuesday; the SARB announces its rate decision on Thursday with the repo rate at 7.25%.

items.title: Nvidia quarterly revenue $115.8bn, ahead of the $108.7bn consensus; guides to $130bn
items.summary: Nvidia reported third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $115.8bn for the quarter to October, up 20% from $96.2bn in the previous quarter and about 103% from $57.0bn a year earlier. That is about 6.5% above the average analyst estimate of $108.7bn. For the fourth quarter, which includes an extra week, the company expects revenue of $130.0bn plus or minus 3% and gross margins of 71%-72%, and assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China.
items.source: NVIDIA Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1 (SEC EDGAR), filed 17 Nov 2026, read by LRC Research 18 Nov 2026 06:47 SAST; consensus from LRC Earnings Calendar (market data feed, 42 estimates), 17 Nov 2026

items.title: October CPI 5.2% year on year, up from 4.5%; 0.7% month on month
items.summary: Stats SA's consumer price index rose 5.2% year on year in October against 4.5% in September, and 0.7% on the month against 0.4% in September. The result matched the 5.2% expected by economists polled by Reuters. Before the release, Nedbank expected higher fuel costs to feed through to other goods and services and core inflation to rise to about 4.5% (September: 4.0%); the actual core figure is not shown because the LRC News Desk has not yet verified it.
items.source: Stats SA October 2026 CPI, as reported by InstaForex, 18 Nov 2026 08:00 UTC (10:00 SAST); Reuters poll and Nedbank via CNBC Africa, 18 Nov 2026 08:53 GMT

items.title: SARB decides on Thursday; markets expect no change
items.summary: The SARB announces its decision on Thursday 19 November with the repo rate at 7.25% after September's 25bp hike. Reuters reported on Wednesday that the bank is widely expected to leave rates unchanged. The benchmark 2035 government bond yield was 8.625% early on Wednesday. September retail sales are due at about 13:00 SAST (Reuters poll: 3.4% year on year).
items.source: Reuters via CNBC Africa, 18 Nov 2026 08:53 GMT; LRC Macro Desk (SARB), 17 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia results above estimates; our rating unchanged
items.summary: Revenue of $115.8bn beat the $108.7bn consensus and the $130bn fourth-quarter outlook is a further step up (company release, 17 Nov 2026). Our BUY rating and $262.56 fair value are unchanged; the LRC Stock Scanner will reassess after the share price reaction. Earnings per share and the share price move are not shown because the LRC News Desk could not verify them against the original sources this morning.
